The fur shows distinct dark stripes on a lighter brown/grey background, characteristic of a mackerel or spotted tabby pattern. The eyes are yellow-green and alert. The lighting is soft and diffuse.

The background exhibits a uniform, plastic-like smoothness rather than natural optical bokeh, suggesting potential generative smoothing, though it is minor.
